- Total revenue reached £32,891.80 TW, representing a +65.6% WoW increase from £19,857.32 LW.
- Total revenue grew +245.6% YoY, demonstrating strong year-over-year performance for ISO week 2011-W10.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER maintained the top position with £2,616.00 TW revenue and 8.0% share TW, though it declined -36.1% WoW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS ranked second with £1,516.30 TW revenue and 4.6% share TW, surging +621.7% WoW.
- CHARLOTTE BAG SUKI DESIGN achieved the largest WoW increase at +1286.1%, growing from £63.26 LW to £876.84 TW.
- VINTAGE UNION JACK BUNTING experienced the largest WoW decrease at -64.8%, falling from £2,288.50 LW to £805.26 TW.
- DOORMAT HEARTS showed the largest YoY increase at +5323.2%, rising from £13.50 LY to current week performance.
- SET OF 3 CAKE TINS PANTRY DESIGN generated the most orders with 47 TW compared to 45 LW.
